heading: What happens when you schedule (68 seconds)
name: What happens when you schedule a call with Honorbrook
description: The four steps to schedule a call with Honorbrook Insurance: open Luay’s page, create your profile, add your details and ask for your meeting. It also covers what to have next to you and how to reach us sooner by phone or text.
transcript: What happens when you schedule a call with Honorbrook? Here are the 4 steps. Select Schedule an appointment. Look for Luay Sadqi at the top. Create your profile with your email address and a password. Add your doctors, prescriptions, pharmacy and current coverage. Then ask for your meeting. Choose how to meet: by phone, at our office in Tysons, or at your home. Pick Life, Health or Annuities, and 30 or 60 minutes. Office and home visits are in Northern Virginia. The first open time is at least 24 hours ahead. To talk sooner, call or text us. Your prescriptions, with the dose and how often you take each one. The doctors and specialists you want to keep. The pharmacy you use. And your current insurance cards. We read it before we talk, so the conversation starts from your information. Creating a profile does not enroll you in anything. You do not need to choose a plan before you schedule. Want to talk it through? Schedule a time at honorbrook-insurance.com or call (301) 615-8289.
